description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2075/64 of 15.06.2018, Panadura D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the amendment of a title registration under the Registration of Title Act for a specific parcel of land in Panadura. It contains detailed land identification information (parcel number, block, cadastral map, village, Grama Niladhari Division, Divisional Secretary's Division, District, and Province) and involves the Commissioner of Title Settlement expunging particulars from a previous gazette notice. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it concerns land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
